metadata.question: Are there more than two lakes (larger than 25 km square) in the region centered at coordinates (7.578886, 38.602260) within a 30 km radius, based on 2022 data?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about the number of lakes larger than 25 km² within a 30 km radius of coordinates (7.578886, 38.602260) based on 2022 data. This requires: 1. Creating a 30 km radius buffer around the given point 2. Using a water body dataset to identify lakes 3. Filtering for lakes larger than 25 km² 4. Counting how many there are I'll use the JRC Global Surface Water dataset which provides water occurrence data and is good for identifying permanent water bodies like lakes. Steps: 1. Define the geometry (point + 30km buffer) 2. Load JRC Global Surface Water dataset 3. Filter for permanent water (high occurrence) 4. Calculate area of each water body 5. Filter for lakes > 25 km² 6. Count the number I need to check for: - Empty collection (C1) - No valid pixels (C2) - Valid result count For water detection, I'll use the "occurrence" band and threshold for permanent water (e.g., >80% occurrence). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([38.602260, 7.578886]); const region = center.buffer(30000); // 30 km radius // 2. Data Acquisition - JRC Global Surface Water dataset const jrc = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater'); const occurrence = jrc.select('occurrence'); // Create water mask (permanent water with occurrence > 80%) const waterMask = occurrence.gt(80); // Convert to vectors to identify individual lakes const vectors = waterMask.reduceToVectors({ geometry: region, scale: 1000, geometryType: 'polygon', eightConnected: false, labelProperty: 'water' }); // Check if collection is empty const count = vectors.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { console.log("No water bodies found in region."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate area for each feature and filter for lakes > 25 km² const lakes = vectors.map(function(feature) { const area = feature.area().divide(1000000); // Convert to km² return feature.set('area_km2', area); }).filter(ee.Filter.gt('area_km2', 25)); const largeLakesCount = lakes.size().getInfo(); // Validate result if (largeLakesCount === null || largeLakesCount === undefined || largeLakesCount < 0) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Output evidence console.log(`Total water bodies: ${count}`); console.log(`Lakes > 25 km²: ${largeLakesCount}`); // Final answer if (largeLakesCount > 2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
